segments.contextAfter: SceneKit connects the vertices in the order specified by the `indices` array, arranged according to the `primitiveType` parameter.This initializer is equivalent to the [`init(data:primitiveType:primitiveCount:bytesPerIndex:)`](scngeometryelement/init(data:primitivetype:primitivecount:bytesperindex:).md) initializer, but does not require an intermediary [`Data`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/Data) object; instead, it automatically infers the necessary allocation size and [`bytesPerIndex`](scngeometryelement/bytesperindex.md) values based on the contents of the `indices` array.
